reasons.claim: The notification is a 2.4 ha regeneration felling in Köping (polygon 3.04 ha). No completed felling overlaps the polygon.

Three eligible site-bound VU species are recorded within 250 m. Lophozia ascendens (moss) is 57 m away, with a 2025 record at 25 m uncertainty. Neckera pennata (moss) is 119 m away, with a 2019 record at 10 m uncertainty. Cerylon impressum (beetle) is 121 m away, with a 2019 record at 10 m uncertainty. Their listed threats include lack of continuity forest and lack of old/large trees. Lophozia ascendens and Cerylon impressum also list lack of dead wood.

Four site-bound forest NT species are also recorded within 250 m, at 18-108 m. These are Crossocalyx hellerianus, Camarops tubulina, Artomyces pyxidatus and Sarcodon squamosus. They are supporting evidence.
Effort is adequate (382 records, 89th percentile). Near-site recording within 250 m is 34 records on 5 days, and one record lies inside the polygon.

uncertainties: The eligible records are outside the polygon. The single record inside the polygon is not identified as red-listed here. Whether the same habitat extends into the polygon is unknown.
Two of the three eligible records are from 2019. Current occupancy is unknown.
Four records within 250 m were dropped for coordinate uncertainty.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the polygon today.
That the felling would affect these species. No cause is established.
next_action: Reviewer should check whether the habitat around the moss and beetle records at 57-121 m extends into the polygon. They should consider a field survey before felling starts.
